records.name: Lobau
records.description_rewritten: A large Danube floodplain/national-park region east of Vienna. This directory name is too broad to pinpoint a cruising site; Vienna's Dechantlacke is a recognised clothing-optional bathing place, but its existence cannot be used as proof that all Lobau is a cruising area.
records.geography: Lobau in Donaustadt, Vienna, with possible reference to Dechantlacke; exact site unverified.
records.access_conditions: Nationalpark Donau-Auen has nature-protection rules. Bathing permitted only in designated areas; stay on approved tracks, no general assumption of access to protected banks.

The name appears very close to another separately listed lead 'FKK und Gay Cruising', perhaps the same woodland section.

records.access_conditions: Outdoor riverside public area; official marked FKK bathing allowed; respect wildlife, site rules and other visitors.

records.name: FKK und Gay Cruising
records.description_rewritten: Despite its generic name, this directory record explicitly identifies woodland within Donauinsel Nordstrand as the place. It is around 0.2 km from the separate Nordstrand record (#316), making same-area overlap very likely, but both research candidates are retained. Dated April 2026 remarks suggest some commenters had visited or observed other visitors, though no independent confirmation was found.
records.geography: Donauinsel Nordstrand woodland near northern designated FKK stretch, Vienna; exact path not independently mapped.
records.access_conditions: Public island recreation area with authorised FKK bathing; public sexual activity is not automatically permitted.
